scope: Try embedded Edge. Find and sort files with more keys.

topics.title: Embedded Edge browser
details: You can now choose webview2 in Web browser options, or say Use embedded Edge. This uses the Edge WebView2 engine in a window owned by Voice Companion. It does not need a Chrome extension. The current browser choice stays as it was until you change it.

The browser has been tested with the same page, form and reading tasks used for other browsers. It has its own profile. Some sign-in flows and sites that need a full browser may not work. You can switch back to another browser in Options.

topics.title: Find files and folders
details: Type a first letter to jump to a file, folder, or drive. Repeat that letter to cycle matches. Type more letters to narrow the list. Backspace removes a letter. Escape clears the name filter first.

Ctrl+F searches names in the current list. Ctrl+Shift+F searches names in the folder and its subfolders. Ctrl+Shift+X clears the search. You can also say Search files for followed by a name, or Search subfolders for followed by a name. Large searches have limits and can be canceled.

topics.title: Sort files with voice or keys
details: Alt+S opens Sort. Ctrl+Shift+1 sorts by name. Ctrl+Shift+2 uses date created. Ctrl+Shift+3 uses date modified. Ctrl+Shift+4 uses date added. Ctrl+Shift+Up chooses ascending. Ctrl+Shift+Down chooses descending. You can say each sort name too.
Date added means when this app first saw the item in this folder. It is not a claim about when an old file was first put there. Dates that Windows does not provide sort last.

topics.title: Reach file controls with Tab
details: Tab and Shift+Tab move between the list and Search, Search subfolders, Sort, Clear search, Drives, and Main menu buttons. Enter activates a button. The File manager menu has the same actions. Alt+Home returns to the main menu.
The command menus were checked for both voice and keyboard routes. Alt+T lets you type the same command you would say, then press Enter.
